scripts.dev:db: docker start dopgate-dev-pg || docker run -d --name dopgate-dev-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=dopgate -p 55433:5432 postgres:17-alpine
scripts.build: bun run build:app && bun run build:docs
scripts.build:ui: bun run clean:ui && bun run --cwd ui build
scripts.build:app: bun run build:ui && cargo build --manifest-path app/Cargo.toml --release
scripts.build:docs: bun run clean:docs && vitepress build docs
scripts.test: bun run test:ui && bun run test:app
scripts.lint: bun run lint:ui && bun run lint:app
scripts.clean: bun run clean:app && bun run clean:ui && bun run clean:docs
scripts.test:db: docker start dopgate-test-pg || docker run -d --name dopgate-test-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=dopgate -p 55432:5432 postgres:17-alpine -c max_connections=400
